subject: Request: Provisional credit for Bluewave Health VPC connectivity delay
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional credit ask for Bluewave - VPC private connect blocker

Hi Mina,

Quick heads-up: Bluewave Health (deal BW-2028-3745) ran into a hard stop during VPC peering validation with our private connect flow this week. Their infra team says the handshake fails intermittently and it blocks their integration testing — they cant go live with Dedicated until we ship a small fix for private-connect auth timeout handling.

Theyre asking for a goodwill accommodation while we remediate and well lose launch momentum if we dont provide something. Proposed customer ask from Sales: a provisional credit bridging the gap until the fix is in prod (either a 10% monthly credit for three months or a one-time $25k concession). Bluewave prefers a single one-off.

Attachments: MA_plan.docx (sketch of mutual action plan), VPC_issue_log.csv (validation failures sample).

Could you advise next steps for an exception? Im flagging Product (Aditya) for ETA and Finance (Priyom) for policy cap. We likely need Exec approval if we exceed standard concession thresholds.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional credit ask for Bluewave - VPC private connect blocker

Thanks Marcus — and thanks for the artifacts. Ill summarize for clarity so we can align:

- Problem: private-connect handshake intermittently failing during VPC peering validation; blocks go-live.
- Customer impact: integration test failure, launch delay risk, high likelihood of churn if not addressed promptly.
- Sales proposal: 10% monthly credit x3 months OR $25k one-off.

Aditya: can you share the realistic ETA to have the auth timeout fix out to canary and then GA? Is there a safe workaround Bluewave can implement in the meantime (customer-managed proxy/NAT) that we can recommend?

Priyom: what are the approval thresholds here? If the one-off stays <= $20k, can Finance approve via the standard concession flow, or do we need VP signoff?

Evelyn: marking you since this is close to launch risk for a large prospect; your call if we route to Exec for signoff.

Related: HubSpot deal BW-2028-3745: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/BW-2028-3745

—Mina
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional credit ask for Bluewave - VPC private connect blocker

Mina / Marcus — thanks for pulling this together and for the logs. I dug into the trace and the underlying root cause is an edge-auth handshake race that appears under certain NAT path MTU conditions. We already have a fix in the private-connect branch; planned canary rollout is 2028-08-12 with GA by 2028-08-22 after validation.

Options to accelerate / mitigate:
- Backport and emergency patch to canary early week of 2028-08-05 (requires 2 dev-weeks + ops validation).
- Temporary workaround for the customer: run a small customer-managed TCP proxy to normalize MTU and retries (requires infra effort on their side, ~2–3 days).

If Sales needs a firm ETA to present to the customer, I can prioritize the backport but wed need Exec approval to pull capacity from current release work.

From a product risk perspective: emergency backport is feasible but non-trivial; timeline could be moved up by ~7–10 days with direct approvals.

Let me know the preferred trade-off (credit vs. backport).

—Aditya
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional credit ask for Bluewave - VPC private connect blocker

Team — finance POV: thanks for the summary. A few points:

- Policy: concessions <= $10k (one-off) or <= 7% monthly credit can be approved by Finance. Anything above requires VP Sales signoff and a written amendment (DocuSign).
- Clawback: we require a clawback clause for provisional credits if the issue is resolved earlier than forecast or if usage exceeds expected thresholds.
- Documentation: send the official MA (mutual action plan) and the proposed amendment text. We have a credit_template.pdf attached for legal/ops routing.

Recommendation: provisional one-off capped at $20k with clawback and sign-off from VP Sales (Evelyn). If Product can push the backport into the week of 2028-08-05 and we get confirmation, reduce the credit to $10k.

Attach: credit_template.pdf
HubSpot/BW-2028-3745 noted for audit.

—Priyom
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional credit ask for Bluewave - VPC private connect blocker

Thanks all for the quick coordination. I approve a provisional one-off credit up to $20,000 under the following conditions:

1) Product confirms a committed backport date no later than 2028-08-06 (Aditya, is this possible if you prioritize?).
2) Legal amendment signed via DocuSign before credit is applied, using the credit_template.pdf and adding a clawback clause.
3) Finance to record the concession against deal BW-2028-3745 and mark as provisional (Priyom).
4) Sales to include the updated ETA and the workaround notes in the MA and confirm customer acceptance of the terms.

Marcus — please prepare the amendment (start from credit_template.pdf) and send to Jenna for signature. Once signed, we can apply the credit and track through finance. If Product cannot commit to the 08-06 backport, we will revisit and cap to $10k.

—Evelyn
VP, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
